The '''Kalpana family''' was an influential family that included among its members [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Kalpana (Supreme Chancellor)/Legends|Kalpana]]. Their dealings with [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] aided in Valorum's rise to the Chancellorship of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
